title: Sample 17-12: Unmarked Intentional Spelling Errors

illustrates.quote: Unmarked Errors. When entire passages have unmarked intentional spelling errors that are to be identified and/or corrected by the reader, transcribe them in uncontracted braille.

blocks.text: This headline and play review have six misspelled words. Circle each one. Then write each misspelled List Word correctly on the lines.
`The new play Pryde of the West, which openned last night at the Crown Theater, is great.` ... `This play will be a big hit, and Ms. Lopez is going to become a star without equell.`
blocks.features: the print review's own middle sentences (Antonio/never been better/costoom/criem/beautifully) are abridged by the transcriber with a '444' ellipsis; no Emboss ellipsis mechanism exists (matching buildModel8's own established '444' precedent)

print.notes: A cell-5 'Proofreading' heading, directions, then a boxed headline (two centred lines) and review paragraph, the whole box wholly uncontracted per 17.10.2's own unmarked-errors mechanism; the transcriber abridges the review's own middle sentences with '444'.
